positions.title: Software Engineer IV - YouTube
positions.description:
The YouTube Living Room (aka Kabuki) team focuses on supporting the YouTube application on devices commonly found in most living rooms. This includes games consoles, TVs, and TV attached devices such as Chromecast, Roku, and Apple TV. Our features are geared towards providing a unique television experience along with tailoring for low-end/low-performance devices.

● NFL Sunday Ticket - UIs, deeplinks, and loggings support for YouTube partnership with the NFL.
  ○ Worked with business partners to develop a logging scheme and deeplinks for NFL ads.
  ○ Created UI for multiview game selections.
  ○ POC for all issues related to Sunday Ticket.
● RTL (Right-to-Left) Support - Appwide support for RTL layout for RTL languages (Hebrew, Arabic, and Farsi).
  ○ ~3% of YouTube watchtime are from RTL languages and this enables users to consume content 
      more naturally.
  ○ Large scale changes with minimum disruption to development flow. 
  ○ Updated testing platform to include RTL so changes are automatically tested for LTR and RTL.
● Report on Watch - Previously, users were required to use a secondary device to flag a video. This feature added an entrypoint to report video natively within the Youtube on Tv app.
  ○ Improved UX by allowing users to report videos natively instead of having to use a secondary device.
  ○ Introduced sign-in flow in order to report the video and resulted in increased signed-in rate.
● Video Menu - A side panel UI component that enables users to take “secondary actions” on videos (not interested, report, add to playlist etc.).
  ○ News article: https://9to5google.com/2019/05/02/youtube-video-menu-tv-app/.
  ○ Implemented UX mocks and advised on app limitation due to low-end devices.
  ○ Set up and connected UI components to endpoints for each flagging action.
  ○ Increased user engagement, subscriptions, and watchtime.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
www.rakuten.com is an e-commerce marketplace founded in 2010. We provide a series of virtual storefront for shoppers to browse and connect online, with the focus on providing high quality, unique merchandise, and a shopper and merchant-friendly experience. 

● Standardized and removed redundancy in SASS files for the entire site.
● Developed a new REST API to retrieve new contents.
● Optimized CMS and HTML templates for SEO.
● Created a coupon page for users to store all of their coupons through the React framework.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Web Services API · Web Application Development · JavaScript

positions.title: Medical Lab Technician/Tester
positions.description: Worked in a bio-hazardous lab environment testing medical devices for cardio complications. Helped developed new testing techniques for new FDA requirements. Trained new employees. Worked proficiently in a team for various medical tests.

positions.title: Clean Room Lab Technician
positions.description: Part of a team that monitors packaging and filling of medical solutions. Interact with the warehouse team and chemists to ensure productivity. Worked in a clean room with full gear and protections.

positions.title: Cable Box Inspector
positions.description: Inspect cable boxes for defects and log the information into a database. Kept up with daily quotas and changing policies. Train new employees under company guideline.

positions.title: Shipping and Receiving
positions.description: Receive and process incoming damage Sony laptop. Log the information into the company database. Package outgoing laptop to customer. Handle errors and invalid addresses. Train new employees.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Works alongside an industry professional as an T.A to teach professional Java to kids from 5th-12th grade
•	Once a student passes through our 10-level curriculum they’re able to take the Computer Science AP exam and the Oracle Certified Associate exam.
•	We’re the only after-school program in the country teaching professional Java to kids this young.
